metadata.description: Installable single-Spark Candidate for text, keyframe, and ordered multimodal-reference generation with TorchAO int8 streamed offload and a verified joint 24-fps video plus 32-kHz stereo audio MP4 export. Physical Spark qualification is pending.
metadata.title: MiniMax H3 Modular Diffusers single Spark

changes.details: The recipe now binds all 280 files in the exact MiniMax H3 revision (498,474,749,480 bytes), including the common pipeline plus T2VA, FL2VA, Ref2VA text encoders, transformers, VAEs, tokenizer/configuration files, and local workflow code needed for offline selection of each supported workflow.
changes.summary: Replace aggregate snapshot with the complete pinned per-file model selection.

changes.details: The current Diffusers compare range is large, but the exact MiniMax H3 modular pipeline source used by this adapter is byte-identical at the selected efabd60d pin and current c5469b7c head. The specialized FL2VA/reference workflows therefore retain their exact runtime pin and model closure.
changes.summary: Retained the MiniMax H3 Diffusers pin because its modular implementation is unchanged.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Removed nvcr.io because digest-pinned base images are fetched through the separate verified base-image transfer and the build runs with pull disabled.
changes.summary: Restricted public build egress to hosts used during Dockerfile execution.

changes.details: The pinned license excludes the European Union, United Kingdom, Republic of Korea, and United States of America; no model artifacts or runtime behavior changed.
changes.summary: Enforced the exact MiniMax H3 Community License territorial exclusions during install and run admission.
Required a simple operator prompt while keeping advanced JSON, keyframes, and multimodal references optional.
Declared the exact single synchronized audio-video MP4 output slot and its aggregate byte bound.
Validate requested geometry and frame count plus exact H.264/AAC, 24 fps, 32 kHz stereo audio, and synchronization before atomic publication.
Declared the exact single synchronized audio-video MP4 output slot and its aggregate byte bound.
Declared typed request, image/keyframe, video-reference, and audio-reference upload slots with bounded file counts and sizes.
Added named smoke-only, balanced, and qualification-reference profiles with exact 3, 30, and 50 model-evaluation contracts.
Changed the installed default from the three-evaluation smoke path to the 30-evaluation balanced profile.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
Replaced the metadata-only binding with an installable Modular Diffusers adapter for text, keyframe, and ordered multimodal-reference workflows.
Pinned the post-integration Diffusers source and current ARM64 PyTorch, Transformers, TorchAO, and PyAV stack in a dedicated offline runtime.
Applied the documented int8 component loading and streamed group-offload recipe with a 960x544 single-Spark default canvas.
Added strict input validation and atomic MP4 export that verifies one 24-fps video stream and one 32-kHz stereo audio stream.
Corrected the 33B model metadata and MiniMax H3 Community License authority while keeping qualification at Candidate pending a physical Spark canary.
Corrected the complete immutable MiniMax H3 snapshot from 614 MB to 498.475 GB and updated dependent disk resources.
Marked the candidate as requiring Modular Diffusers and a model-specific joint video/audio exporter before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of MiniMax H3 diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
